workData.title: HandsOn — Event & Community Platform
workData.longDescription: Comprehensive event management and hands-on learning platform enabling organizers to coordinate community workshops, track real-time attendance capacity, and manage multi-track schedules.

teardown.problemSolved: Community organizers lacked a unified system to coordinate volunteer-driven workshops, enforce real-time seat capacity, and synchronize multi-track event schedules without manual spreadsheet overhead.
teardown.architecture: Modular Node.js & Express.js REST API backed by normalized MongoDB collections for event registrations, organizer RBAC guards, and atomic capacity counters.
teardown.performanceChallenges: Eliminated redundant client re-renders across filterable event feeds using memoized state selectors, optimistic registration mutations, and responsive Next/Image asset delivery.

highlights: Engineered responsive dashboards with real-time registration state synchronization
Implemented protected RESTful endpoints with role-based organizer controls
Optimized asset delivery and mobile touch interactions down to 360px viewports

workData.title: NewCare — Healthcare Appointment Portal
workData.longDescription: Role-based healthcare appointment booking and patient record portal featuring doctor schedule discovery, concurrency-safe slot booking, and longitudinal medical history tracking.

teardown.problemSolved: Clinics and patients faced fragmented consultation scheduling, double-booked doctor time slots, and disconnected medical histories across patient, doctor, and administrator workflows.
teardown.architecture: Modular NestJS/Node.js backend with multi-role JWT RBAC guards (Admin, Doctor, Patient) and transactional PostgreSQL/MongoDB slot constraints preventing concurrent double-bookings.
teardown.performanceChallenges: Engineered conflict-free concurrency-safe slot locking and zero-jank multi-step appointment wizards with sub-100ms specialty and availability filtering.

highlights: Created dynamic doctor availability time-slot filtering with transactional locks
Implemented multi-role JWT authentication isolating Patient, Doctor, and Admin portals
Verified critical booking and authentication journeys with Playwright E2E specs

workData.title: Ndemy — Learning Management System
workData.longDescription: Feature-rich Learning Management System with structured course catalogs, video lesson progression telemetry, student enrollment pipelines, and instructor publishing studios.

teardown.problemSolved: Educators and learners needed a scalable LMS supporting structured video curricula, real-time lesson completion tracking, and role-separated instructor publishing workflows.
teardown.architecture: Full-stack Node.js/Express and MongoDB architecture utilizing compound-indexed collections for courses, student enrollments, and lecture progress telemetry with JWT RBAC middleware.
teardown.performanceChallenges: Cut catalog search and curriculum query latency by 30% via covered MongoDB aggregation pipelines, debounced client filtering, and lazy-loaded video lecture modules.

highlights: Built modular video lecture player with persistent lesson completion telemetry
Designed multi-role access control separating instructor studios and learner dashboards
Implemented instant course catalog search with category filters and pagination

workData.title: Nobot — Streaming AI Assistant
workData.longDescription: Interactive AI assistant platform featuring real-time token streaming, multi-turn conversation memory, syntax-highlighted Markdown code blocks, and low-latency UI rendering.

teardown.problemSolved: Standard request-response AI chat wrappers suffer from high perceived latency during long completions and break layout structure when rendering multi-language code blocks.
teardown.architecture: Asynchronous token-streaming client-server pipeline with structured context window management, deterministic error recovery, and AST-based Markdown code rendering.
teardown.performanceChallenges: Prevented main-thread layout thrashing during high-frequency token streams by throttling auto-scroll pinning and memoizing completed conversation nodes.

highlights: Implemented real-time token streaming for sub-200ms time-to-first-token UX
Integrated syntax-highlighted Markdown renderer with one-click code copying
Engineered responsive conversational layout with zero horizontal overflow

workData.title: Enterprise Inventory & Stock System
workData.longDescription: Enterprise inventory and stock control system featuring atomic stock-level transactions, low-inventory threshold alerts, automated invoice generation, and supplier ledgers.

teardown.problemSolved: Warehouse and retail teams struggled with stock count drift, delayed low-inventory alerts, and manual invoice reconciliation across multi-supplier product catalogs.
teardown.architecture: RESTful Node.js backend using atomic database stock decrement operations, indexed SKU lookup tables, supplier relational ledgers, and HTTP-only JWT session security.
teardown.performanceChallenges: Optimized multi-collection inventory aggregation queries and real-time KPI telemetry cards to render thousands of SKU transaction records without pagination lag.

highlights: Built atomic stock decrement transactions preventing negative inventory race conditions
Created automated low-stock alert notifications and revenue analytics summaries
Implemented role-based session authentication with protected API routes

workData.title: QR Code Studio — Vector Payload Engine
workData.longDescription: High-speed client-side QR code studio with instant payload encoding, custom foreground/background color matrices, error-correction tuning, and lossless SVG/PNG export.

teardown.problemSolved: Most web QR generators route sensitive URLs through third-party tracking servers, add redirect latency, or lock high-DPI vector exports behind commercial paywalls.
teardown.architecture: 100% client-side zero-network encoding pipeline utilizing HTML5 Canvas and SVG path matrices with configurable Reed-Solomon error correction levels (L, M, Q, H).
teardown.performanceChallenges: Achieved sub-16ms 60fps real-time vector re-rendering during continuous color-picker and payload mutations with high-DPI Blob serialization.

highlights: Pure client-side zero-latency vector rendering with complete data privacy
Custom color contrast controls and precision Reed-Solomon error correction
One-click clipboard copy and lossless high-DPI SVG/PNG download

workData.title: NRL — High-Speed URL Shortener
workData.longDescription: Low-latency URL shortener and link management utility featuring collision-resistant slug generation, instant QR pairing, and atomic click-through analytics.

teardown.problemSolved: Long, complex URLs degrade sharing across social and mobile channels and lack lightweight click-through telemetry and instant QR code pairing.
teardown.architecture: Collision-resistant Nanoid hash generator backed by unique-indexed MongoDB slug documents, atomic click-counter updates, and fast HTTP 301/302 redirect handlers.
teardown.performanceChallenges: Engineered sub-millisecond slug lookups using covered database indexes and strict client/server URL protocol validation.

highlights: Sub-millisecond redirect lookups powered by unique-indexed slug hashes
Strict URL schema sanitization and instant error feedback states
One-click link copying paired with automatic mobile QR code generation
